title: KAITO — A Song For The Restless〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Ah... Guh...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hey, are you okay?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (He's holding his knee! Could he be inju—)

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...!
Damn it...! The ball...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hey, wait...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I guess he can't see me after all...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: No time... I don't have time...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (The restlessness and anxiety I felt before is getting stronger...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hey! What is it you're getting so worked up about?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Argh! I need to make it in time, no matter what...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (It's no good. He can't hear me either.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (If I could just understand his feelings a bit better, that might help me get started on a solution...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wah! Wh-What was that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This is a fragment of a feeling...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see.
His feelings got stronger and came spilling out.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I may be able to get in touch with his feelings through this fragment.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (To tell the truth, I was hoping to speak with him and get it in his own words... Sorry, I'll be taking a look.)

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: My bad, this is the worst timing...

rows.Speaker: Teammate A
rows.Line: Don't apologize, idiot. This isn't your fault...

rows.Speaker: Teammate B
rows.Line: He's right, Captain! If you hadn't made that play, we never woulda made our comeback!

rows.Speaker: Teammate C
rows.Line:
Nobuyuki...
We'll be waiting for you on the court.

rows.Speaker: Teammate D
rows.Line:
Believe in us!
We'll be waiting 'cause we believe in you!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Got it... I'll be back for sure.
Until then, I'm leaving the team to you.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Doctor...
Could you repeat that...?

rows.Speaker: Doctor
rows.Line: He will be able to play basketball again...as a hobby. But it may prove very difficult for him to reach the level where he can handle intensive play in competition.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: It'll just be difficult, not impossible, right?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: What do I need to do to get back on the court?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see...
This is so he can keep the promise he made his teammates...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (It sounded like he's their captain as well... He must feel a great sense of responsibility, and the fact he got injured would only add to that.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (On top of it all, there isn't even an easy way for him to return to the court...)

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I know those guys, and I know they'll win the next match too. So I also need to... I need to hurry up and get back to them...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think that might be a bit too much to carry all on your own.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Times like these are when we've got to step in.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (It's an important promise with your treasured teammates. Of course you want to keep it.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I'm sure it was a huge shock to hear that it'd be difficult to play like you used to...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Even so, you chose to fight without ever giving up.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Your feelings are just that strong. Believe in yourself more, there's no need to rush and overdo things.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Believe like your friends, who trust that you'll return.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Please. Let this get through...!)

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Is this...music?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'm glad...
It seems I got through.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Um, who are you...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Here, have a seat before we talk.
Come on, ball down!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Oh... No, I need to practice...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Your knee hurts, right? You'll end up putting extra weight on your good leg if you practice like that, and wouldn't that just lead to bad form?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If you get where I'm coming from, then it's time for a break!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Don't you think it'd upset your friends who are waiting for you if they knew you were pushing yourself so hard?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Yeah...you're right...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Sorry about this.
I just suddenly showed up and started lecturing you.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Oh, no... To be honest, I knew what I was doing was wrong.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
But I can't stop the anxiety...
When I'm in the hospital bed, I feel like I just can't sit still. Even though I know now isn't the time to be practicing like this...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: It feels like I could be spending my time practicing and get back on the court sooner that way, so I worry that I'll be too late if I don't practice...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I see... This fragment SEKAI must have come about because his feelings of wanting to practice and return to the court are so strong right now.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In that case, how about listening to a song that can help alleviate your anxiety?

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Huh...? A song...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Songs can get close to the hearts of all different kinds of people.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Some give courage to those who want courage, and others soothe those faced with anxiety.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If you don't mind, I can sing you a song. I know a lot of good ones.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Oh...
By the way, who...are you?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh dear. It seems I'd forgotten to tell you my name.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm KAITO. Capital K-A-I-T-O.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I believe there's one in your world as well.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: KAITO, the VIRTUAL SINGER. He communicates feelings through song.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh... I wanted to keep talking for a bit longer, but it seems about time to say goodbye.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
See you later, Nobuyuki.
I hope you won't forget what we just talked about.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: My name, how did you...?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll be by your side watching, so don't push yourself too hard.
Hospital Room

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Mmh...

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line: Nobuyuki! What a relief...!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Wait... My practice...

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line: You know you can't be slipping out of your room like that! What are you going to do if you trip and make your injury worse?

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line: If you hold tight for just a bit longer, you'll be able to start your rehabilitation. For now, you need to rest.

rows.Speaker: Nurse
rows.Line: And I'm sure it'd upset your teammates who come in to visit you if they knew you were pushing yourself so hard.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I got another talking to...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Wait, “another”...?

Here, have a seat before we talk.
Come on, ball down!
Don't you think it'd upset your friends who are waiting for you if they knew you were pushing yourself so hard?
Songs can get close to the hearts of all different kinds of people.
Some give courage to those who want courage, and others soothe those faced with anxiety.
If you don't mind, I can sing you a song. I know a lot of good ones.

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Right... That VIRTUAL SINGER...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I'd heard of them before, but never actually gave them a listen...

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: I think that one's name was...
